dialogues.speaker: Ruying
dialogues.text: The inn owner said that the person who was my neighbor was a researcher or something, and wrote papers all day.

dialogues.speaker: Ruying
dialogues.text: Too bad it seems like he disappeared a few days ago, and the room's been let out. The people who moved in are a couple who can't stop yapping.

dialogues.speaker: Ruying
dialogues.text: If I'd arrived a few days ago, I'd be done with my business and on my way, instead of being bothered by the noise all night and unable to sleep...
